identity_layers.person_identity: stable root identity addressed by BranchID
identity_layers.peer_id: live transport/session routing identity; may rotate
identity_layers.relay_node_id: relay operator identity; not a user identity

payload.authority: signed identity root key only; carrier accounts, aliases, relays, mirrors, topics and search ranks are candidate evidence

route_hint.authority: hint only; relay identity is proven during attachment

federation.mesh_distribution: bounded signed observations and HAVE/WANT summaries
federation.equal_sequence_policy: exact canonical wrapper duplicate is idempotent; distinct canonical wrappers for the same BranchID and sequence are rejected as equivocation
